sources.title: Tourist visa application, electronic visa grant and arrival documents
sources.officialityEvidence: Actual official Tourist product guidance read. It links the electronic application, lists the required supporting documents, and explicitly describes email delivery of the approved visa grant and presentation at entry. It does not treat an approval as an instruction to collect the visa at the border.

policies.title: Colombian and Palestinian ordinary passports: Solomon Islands tourist eVisa
policies.summary: Solomon Islands Immigration currently accepts both nationalities for the Tourist visa product. It sends the approved visa grant letter by email before travel; this is an eVisa, not a visa on arrival.
conditions: This concerns ordinary passports for short tourism, not diplomatic, service, special travel documents, transit, work or residence. The Tourist nationality menu displays Colombia and Palestinian.

Supply a valid passport biodata page, a cover letter explaining the visit, travel itinerary and return or onward ticket, hotel confirmation if using a hotel, and evidence of sufficient funds as required.

Wait for approval before travelling and bring a copy of the emailed grant. Follow the dated conditions of the issued grant; current public official descriptions do not establish a consistent numerical stay for these two passport relationships.

application.label: Open the official Solomon Islands Tourist visa guide and application
steps: Use Apply Online on the official Tourist visa page. Register with an email address you can access, sign in, and complete the Tourist application with your passport details.
Attach the requested passport and travel documents, submit the application, and follow any further instructions in your account.
Wait for the visa decision and approved grant letter by email before travelling. Bring a copy to present on entry.
